messages.content: 想像一下你是一個無人機操作員。你目前正在操作一架位於天空中的無人機，座標為（5，7）。你被要求將無人機移動到一個新的座標（10，15）。到達新座標後，你又被要求將無人機移動到另一個座標（20，25）。你能用歐幾里得範數法計算出無人機總共飛行的距離嗎？

function.name: math_hypot
function.description: Calculate the Euclidean norm, sqrt(sum(squares)), the length of the vector from the origin to point (x, y) which is the hypotenuse of the right triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

z.description: Optional. The z-coordinate value. Default is 0.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate total flight distance using Euclidean norm. They have coordinates: start at (5,7). Move to (10,15). Then move to (20,25). We need to compute distances between successive points: distance from (5,7) to (10,15), then from (10,15) to (20,25). Sum them.

We can use the math_hypot function. But we need to call it twice. The function signature: math_hypot({x: number, y: number, z?: number}). It returns any. We need to provide x and y differences? Actually the function calculates sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2). So we need to pass differences: dx, dy. For each segment: dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1. So first segment: dx=10-5=5, dy=15-7=8. So hypot(5,8)= sqrt(25+64)= sqrt(89)=9.433... Next segment: dx=20-10=10, dy=25-15=10. hypot(10,10)= sqrt(100+100)= sqrt(200)=14.142... Sum = 23.575... Provide answer.

We should call the function twice. Use the tool.
